# Temperature Regulation Medications
These medications help to regulate body temperatures.
Leporazine is standard to quickly normalize a patient's body temperature. [bold]Do NOT use Leporazine on small animals. It causes major burns![/bold]
Peranol is extremely useful to give to [textlink="Hydrakin" link="Hydrakin"] to help them self-regulate, as it has no overdose limit and lasts for minutes per unit.
Ibuprofen has weak temperature-regulating effects. Otherwise, it's a slow-acting brute medication.
Hercuri greatly lowers body temperature in the dead and strongly heals heat damage, making it useful for victims of plasma fires or other accidents.
